note: The cue sheet of experiment 11: the sound effects and the ambience of the whole reference video, a first draft. Times are seconds of the picture. A cue names a recipe of recipes.ts (events of the engine's kinds) or a store entry of experiment 10 (an accepted sound through its effect nodes). The level is in dB under the sound that leads the moment; a stored cue's level is against the accepted hit on the wall, as module-4.json sets it. Dialogue and music are notes only and are not designed. The scenes and the cue times come from a frame sheet at 2 frames a second, a scene-cut detector and the onsets of the reference's audio, measured privately; no sample of the reference is used.
